title: Simultaneous finite covering-family lifting
statement: Let J be a small filtered category and F : J → Cat a strict diagram [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let P_j be precoverages such that every covering presieve has finite uncurried arrow set, and every transition functor sends covering presieves to covering presieves. Let V be a cocone whose object and arrow cocones [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor] are colimits of sets. Let Q be a precoverage on its vertex, with membership equivalent to equality-transport of the image of a stage covering presieve. Given a finite indexed Q-covering f_i : X_i → S and finite indexed Q-coverings g_ik : Y_ik → X_i for each i, there exist one stage j, objects T, A_i, B_ik, arrows a_i : A_i → T and b_ik : B_ik → A_i, such that V_j(T)=S, the presieves of a and each b_i are P_j-covering, and the image arrows V_j(a_i) and V_j(b_ik) equal f_i and g_ik respectively as objects of the arrow category. This lifts the two families separately; it asserts no covering property of their composites.

source.place: Tag 09YL, finite-diagram observation and verification of axiom (2)

proof.text: Use hQ for a stage representative of S. Apply the one-layer fixed-stage lifting lemma to the outer family, with a singleton target index. Read its source equalities from the image Arrow equalities. Apply the same lemma to the finite inner families with those fixed stage sources as targets. Transition the outer family along the resulting stage arrow; hcover and Presieve.map_ofArrows preserve its covering property. Cocone naturality preserves its target and image arrows. The inner family already has the required cover and image properties.

theorem colimit_site_covering_families_lift
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X → Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (V : Cocone F) (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V)) (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    (hQ : ∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
      ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X)
        (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
        S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R)
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] {S : V.pt} {X : ι → V.pt}
    (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ S) (hf : Presieve.ofArrows X f ∈ Q S)
    {σ : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Finite (σ i)] {Y : ∀ i, σ i → V.pt}
    (g : ∀ i j, Y i j ⟶ X i)
    (hg : ∀ i, Presieve.ofArrows (Y i) (g i) ∈ Q (X i)) :
    ∃ (j : J) (T : F.obj j) (A : ι → F.obj j)
      (B : ∀ i, σ i → F.obj j) (a : ∀ i, A i ⟶ T) (b : ∀ i k, B i k ⟶ A i),
      (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj T = S ∧
      Presieve.ofArrows A a ∈ P j T ∧
      (∀ i, Presieve.ofArrows (B i) (b i) ∈ P j (A i)) ∧
      (∀ i, Arrow.mk ((V.ι.app j).toFunctor.map (a i)) = Arrow.mk (f i)) ∧
      (∀ i k, Arrow.mk ((V.ι.app j).toFunctor.map (b i k)) = Arrow.mk (g i k))
